pitch:
Kashkool (كشكول) — Autonomous EdTech OS for Egyptian tutoring centers

What you get:
- 0.3-second NFC/QR check-in: Student taps, green light, thermal receipt prints. No typing, no waiting, works offline.
- 1-tap daily settlement at 11 PM: Open app, tap "Settle", every teacher paid correctly. Immutable ledger prevents disputes.
- Family Wallet: Parents top up via Instapay / Vodafone Cash / Fawry. Auto-reconciled. Zero cash leakage.
- AI Academic Rescue: Student fails a quiz → auto-generates personalized practice sheet in seconds.
- Teacher DRM: Your content watermarked, screenshot-blocked, leak-traced. Teachers keep their IP.
- Super-Admin Radar: Live Egypt heatmap, kill-switches, ghost impersonation. Control everything from one screen.

Price: EGP 2,500/month per center (all features included). EGP 800/month for independent teachers.
Free for students and parents.

No setup fees. 14-day free trial. Onboarding in 10 minutes — we give you NFC tags and thermal printer config.
